Item.Description: This rule indicates that the articles are subject to duty at the rate set forth herein in lieu of the rate provided in chapters 1 to 98, inclusive.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff will not be accepted by AES.
This rule indicates that the duties provided for are cumulative duties which apply in addition to the duties, if any, otherwise imposed on the articles involved.
This rule indicates that the duties provided for Russian products duties which apply in addition to the duties, if any, otherwise imposed on the articles involved.

This rule indicates that the articles are repaired, altered, processed or otherwise changed in condition abroad. If the article, as returned to the United States, is subject to a specific or compound rate of duty, such rate shall be converted to the ad valorem rate which when applied to the full value of such article determined in accordance with said section 402 would provide the same amount of duties as the specific or compound rate.
This rule indicates that the articles require the submission of a formal entry for commercial shipments regardless of its value.

This rule indicates that the articles are assembled abroad with components produced in the United States. If the imported article is subject to a specific or compound rate of duty, the total duties shall be reduced in such proportion as the cost or value of such products of the United States bears to the full value of the imported article.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff require its value to be declared at its alternate tariff line.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AGOA Textile Claims.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for CBTPA Textile Claims.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for CAFTA Claims.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for ATPDEA Textile and Tuna Claims.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are exempt from the cotton fee assessments.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariffs require the specified secondary tariff numbers.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff require a Wool License No.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are not subject to duty-free treatment if the country of origin is the Freely Associated States. The column 1 rate of duty applies.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff require a MID that starts with the Country of Origin.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff allow no SPI to be declared.

This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are associated with Haiti Hope Legislation. Those articles require visa numbers and their values and quantities should be reported on their alternate tariff numbers.

This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for Chilean Trade Preference level, but do not require the country of export to be 'CL' and are excluded from MPF exemptions.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are goods imported from Singapore and treated as originating goods under general note 25(M) for purposes of the SG FTA.

This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for Singapore Trade Preference Level, but do not require the country of export to be 'SG' and are excluded from MPF exemptions. Additionally they require a Singapore Certification number issued by the government of Singapore.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff require reporting of Lacey Act data.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO1 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO2 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO4 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO5 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO6 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO7 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS MO8 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff must declare an Importer Permit Number for TTB Program at the time of entry.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff must declare a COLA Number for TTB Program at the time of entry.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff must declare a Foreign Certificatate for TTB Program at the time of entry.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff require TTB Price
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS EG1 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS EG2 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are eligible for AMS PN1 Program.
This rule indicates that articles classified under the tariff are exempt from HMF.
